verification.note: migrated from data/antibiogram-raw.json: extracted from the source PDF, then re-verified cell by cell by a second reader (2026)

notes: Source: Panigrahi et al., Cureus 2025;17(10):e94006 (KIMS Bhubaneswar). PDF read via PyMuPDF text extraction (pdftoppm/pdftotext unavailable). Data taken from Table 2 (page 10), which prints Sensitive/Intermediate/Resistant counts and percentages for each of 13 drugs across the whole study population and 4 subgroups (ICU, non-ICU, CAI, HAI). I extracted the overall Total (n=7,942) Sensitive % values as printed (%S only; Intermediate not added). Values match the abstract/text (tigecycline 74.79%S, gentamicin 39.45%S, meropenem 34.34%S, piptazo 32.44%S). Note the scope hint 'cipro 78.4%R' corresponds to the Resistant column (6,227, 78.40%R); the reported %S for ciprofloxacin is 19.08% (I:2.50%), so no %R conversion was needed as %S is printed directly. CPS = cefoperazone-sulbactam mapped to non-canonical token 'cefoperazonesulbactam' (distinct from plain cefoperazone). Only organism studied is K. pneumoniae; other Klebsiella species excluded by authors. Subgroup rows (ICU/non-ICU/CAI/HAI) also available in Table 2 but only the overall pooled figures extracted here. VITEK 2, CLSI 2022 breakpoints.
